0022600191.text: The Cavaliers (4-4) are 3-1 at home and have dropped their last two games, sitting 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 2 games back. The Knicks (4-4) have won their last two, are 7th in the East, and are 3rd in the Atlantic, 3.5 games back. Cleveland will be without Jarrett Allen (knee) and Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain), while New York will be without Josh Hart (ankle), and the teams have no games yet this season. Last season, the Cavaliers lost 1-2 in the regular season and 0-4 in the playoffs, with their most recent meeting a 130-93 loss in Cleveland on May 25, 2026.
